title: Stage footwear fit record
passage:
Fitting desk memo | Malvern Stage Footwear

Every dancer at this fitting will bring the socks they normally wear on stage. Some pairs of shoes look the same from the outside but were made on different foot forms. The fitting card must identify the form used for each shoe, not just the overall size. We may swap a left shoe independently of the right one. At a quick change the dressers line up the shoes toe-first on the rack, with the labels inside the heels out of sight. Their diagram above the rack shows a broad silver band under “L” and a narrow one under “R.”

If a dancer asks for extra space around the toes, first offer a thinner removable insole. A thinner insole is [139] _____ a larger shoe: it creates room above the foot without changing the length of the shoe.

Before changing a fit that works, ask dancers what they mean by “make them match.” Rina had asked us to make her shoes match, but said both shoes felt comfortable in the test. She asked to see the stage video once with the lights down and once with the opening cue. In the dim run, she watched the whole step through and said nothing. In the lit run, she stopped the video just as a bright flash came from the left toe; the right toe still showed silver. “That bit,” she said, “not what we saw before.” The maker can use the same silver in either width with a soft finish that does not flash under that light. [140] _____ The two sides can be ordered with different combinations if this works best for the dancer.

Before submitting an order, count two comfortable turns with the exact shoes and insoles the dancer selects. The turns need not be consecutive: a trial of a different setup does not erase a turn made with the selected pair. Mina’s first comfortable turn used a standard right insole, though its line on the card mistakenly said “thin.” The assistant checked the insole and corrected the line. Mina then made a comfortable turn with a thin right insole but asked for the standard one to go back in. Everything else stayed the same. [141] _____

Orders placed through the desk will be shipped to the theater. The maker can look up a shoe's length from its form number, but the form number does not tell the maker which insole went into the trial shoe. A dancer has selected form 12 for both feet, with a thin insole on the left and the standard insole on the right. The assistant has typed “pair: 12” in the order email. [142] _____
passageZh:
試穿台備忘錄｜馬爾文舞台鞋履

每位來試鞋的舞者都會帶來平時在舞台上穿的襪子。有些鞋外觀相同，但製作時使用的鞋楦不同。試穿卡必須標示每隻鞋使用的鞋楦，不能只記整雙鞋的尺寸。左右兩隻鞋可以各自調換。 快速換裝時，服裝組會把鞋尖朝外排在架上，鞋跟內側的標籤從外面看不到。架子上方的對照圖在「L」下畫了寬銀邊，在「R」下畫了窄銀邊。

若舞者希望腳趾周圍多一些空間，請先提供較薄、可取出的鞋墊。較薄的鞋墊[139] _____大一號的鞋：它增加腳背上方的空間，但不會改變鞋長。

如果鞋子穿起來已經合腳，舞者說「想要兩邊一樣」時，先問她指的是哪一點。瑞娜希望兩只鞋看起來一致，但她說試穿時兩腳都很舒服。她請大家先看一遍燈光較暗時的舞台影片，再看一遍開場燈光亮起時的版本。光線較暗的版本，她看完整個步伐，沒說什麼。開場燈光亮起的版本，左腳鞋尖反射出一陣亮光時，她按了暫停；右腳仍看得出銀色。她說：「就是剛剛那一下，不是前一段我們看到的樣子。」製鞋師可以保留銀色，把任一寬度的銀邊改成低光澤，在那盞燈下就不會閃。[140] _____ 若左右腳採用不同搭配比較適合舞者，也可以分開訂。

送出訂單前，請確認舞者穿著實際選定的鞋與鞋墊，舒服地完成兩次轉身。兩次不必連續；中途試穿別的搭配，不會使選定搭配的轉身紀錄失效。米娜第一次舒服地完成轉身時，右腳用的是標準鞋墊，不過卡片上誤寫成「薄」。助理查過鞋墊後更正了紀錄。米娜接著換上右腳薄鞋墊，也舒服地完成了一次轉身，但她請助理把標準鞋墊換回去。其餘搭配都沒變。[141] _____

透過試穿台下訂的鞋會寄到劇院。製鞋人員可從鞋楦編號查到鞋長，但無法從該編號得知試穿時用的是哪種鞋墊。一位舞者左右腳都選了 12 號鞋楦，左腳配薄鞋墊，右腳配標準鞋墊。助理在訂單郵件裡打了「雙腳：12 號」。[142] _____
